title: Strongly convergent matrix models for $q$-Gaussian algebras
summary: We construct strongly convergent finite-dimensional random matrix models for finite $q$-Gaussian family in the range $\vert q \vert < \sqrt{2}-1$. The construction has two stages. First, we show that normalized sums of graph-product semicirculars over an Erdos-Renyi graph satisfy the $q$-Toeplitz relations up to an operator norm error converging to zero in probability. Using ultraproduct methods, this yields complete strong convergence, uniformly over all matrix coefficient dimensions, for noncommutative polynomials with bounded degree.
